In view of the above, it is to state that, the ghee samples collected from Tanker No. AP26 TC 4779 & TN 02 BA 9459 on 06-07-2024, and TN 02 BB 2151 & TN 02 BB 2070 on 12-07-2024 were analyzed for quality as per the test parameters prescribed under the Food Safety and Standards Regulation by NABL-accredited

laboratory as per ISO/IEC 17025:2017.

From the obtained results, it is evident that the ghee supplied to TTD through
tankers nos. AP26 TC 4779, TN 02 BA 9459, TN 02 BB 2151 & TN 02 BB 2070
were confirmed to be adulterated. The presence of high levels (range: 156.917 -
208.851 mg/kg of the sample) of β-Sitosterol (plant sterol) in the supplied
consignments of ghee indicates that the ghee is adulterated with the fat of
vegetable origin. The FSSAI specification for ghee is absence of β-Sitosterol.
Presence of such high levels of β-Sitosterol, which is a marker for the presence of
vegetable oil, clearly indicates that the consignments of ghee supplied by the
company were highly adulterated. Moreover, the fatty acid composition also did not
comply with that of ghee, which indicates the presence of foreign fat (Table -2, 3, 4
& 5). The presence of β-sitosterol and variation in the contents of many of the fatty
acids in all the four samples tested do not comply with the specifications laid down
under Food Safety and Standards Regulation, 2011 and hence, can be declared as
adulterated, as per FSS Regulation, 2011.

Further, three of the samples tested (Tables 3, 4 and 5) did not comply with
the saponification value range stipulated by FSSAI, which is a clear indication of
adulteration of the samples.

In view of the above, show cause notices were issued vide 5ᵗʰ reference cited
to M/s AR Dairy Food Private Limited, Dindigul, to “show cause” as to why suitable
action should not be taken to blacklist the company duly forfeiting the EMD & SD
amounts and penalty of 5% within 7 (seven) days from the date of receipt of this
show cause notice, failing which it is construed that company have nothing to say in
this regard and suitable action as warranted under contract agreement shall be
initiated against company on the evidence of available records without any further
notice.
